parent_baseline: LFM_V8_B3_SEMIFINAL (same head, same training data, same predictions; full-model runtime, official 34.75)
primary_changed_factor: identical B3 student head and predictions to LFM_V8_B3_SEMIFINAL; only the runtime changes. The head is the V8 B3 recipe (RetargetVid native + 90-deg rotated + LIVE-YT-VC GT pools, NO PHD2 KD), re-run through the vision-tower-only path. LFM2.5-VL-450M keeps 354,483,968 of 448,718,848 parameters (79.0%, 709 MB) in the language model, which the student forward pass never executes: the deployed call is model.model.vision_tower(pixel_values, spatial_shapes, pixel_attention_mask) with no text prompt, no generate, no projector. The shell is built from config (reads no weight file) and only the 197 vision-tower tensors are read from safetensors, so the language model bytes are never loaded at inference. Declared weight drops 903,762,857 B (861.9 MB, k_size 0.90) -> 177,964,689 B (169.8 MB, k_size 0.95). This replaces LFM_V9_VISIONONLY_SEMIFINAL, which mounted the PHD2-KD A1 head that scored 34.61 raw against B3's 38.76 - the KD head is a confirmed negative on the official drop, so the k_size coefficient is re-attached to the stronger head. No score is predicted; the change is a coefficient on an unchanged prediction set.

fixed_conditions.path: B0 EMA alpha .25 on the free axis, B0 thumbnail-diff shot resets, hold within shot; centres from the student head argmax window
fixed_conditions.fallback: B0 observation on head failure / before first keyframe

training.data: RetargetVid 6-annotator mean crop IoU (native + 90-deg rotated) + LIVE-YT-VC frozen spatial_crop_v1 window GT; no teacher output, no PHD2 KD, no official/semifinal test data
training.splits: RV train 001-030+621-700 (110 src), LIVE train 1115 src / live_dev 124 src (selection) / live_confirmation 227 src (confirmation, fresh)

model_revision: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-450M@fc6221ca597f3315e4f82fc2df606783267b34ba (vision tower only, Siglip2 NaFlex encoder) + V8 B3 student head
runtime: transformers 5.1, torch_npu 2.10.0, CANN 9.0.0, Ascend 910A; vision tower fp16 eager (no text prompt, no generate), head fp32; attn eager on the vision config (the default backend calls aclnnIsNegInf, unsupported on 910A); torch.npu jit_compile=False
prompt: NONE_HEAD (no text prompt at inference; vision-tower tokens only)

components.name: LFM2.5-VL-450M vision_tower only (Siglip2 NaFlex encoder, 85,843,200 params fp16; language model and projector not loaded at inference)
V8 B3 student candidate-utility head (fp32, 2305-512-128 MLP + 2-layer self-attention, 129 legal windows, multi-geometry GT pools, NO PHD2 KD)

declared_size_note: 177,964,689 B = 169.8 MB (2^20) or 178.0 MB (1e6); inside the 100-500 MB tier so k_size = 0.95 vs 0.90 for the full-model packages. The language model is excluded because it is not loaded when the predictions are produced, the quantity rules 01 s4.2 measures. Same declaration basis as LFM_V9_VISIONONLY_SEMIFINAL; only the mounted head changed.
notes: Corrective re-package: VISIONONLY first mounted the PHD2-KD A1 head (34.61 raw), which the official drop showed is a -4.15 negative transfer vs the B3 head (38.76 raw). This package keeps the vision-only runtime win but mounts the stronger B3 head. Inference-equivalence of the vision-only path was verified on the prior package (point diff 0.00031 < self-jitter 0.00053; box IoU 0.9974). Boundary-frame tile-layout crashes are handled by a per-frame centred fallback flag so no video drops predictions.
